description.value: The Consortium's principal base in this galaxy: two pressure modules, a mast and a walled yard, sited eleven kilometres downwind of the nearest terraces at a distance that was agreed rather than chosen. Staffing is six. It has been occupied without a break since 2246.

notes.value: The site record gives the eleven-year rotation as a scientific interval. It is the interval at which a ship is available, and the sector office has stopped correcting people who assume otherwise.
